ravi: quick follow-up from the RFC: we hit a quality regression when switching from fp8->int8 for the attention layer on a subset of short-chat prompts. sample failure in logs.

leen: what was the failure profile?

ravi: tokens dropped near punctuation, coherence loss in 2% of cases. looks correlated with headwise scale divergence.

ops_bob: ops observed small but consistent cache invalidation spikes when bitwidth flips mid-session. recommend marking transitions in response header.

sam_t: agreed. propose these immediate mitigations: 1) add head-variance gate: if head_var > 0.25, force int8 on that layer; 2) emit header `x-precision-transition`; 3) canary the change 0.5% traffic.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: precision-guard-headvar -> 0.5% at 2024-05-20T12:00:00Z
avi: action items: sam_t to implement gate (ETA today), ops_bob to add header-aware cache invalidation (ETA tomorrow), leen to run focused regression tests on short-chat corpus (ETA 24h). will reconvene after canary metrics. :+1:
